name: ReverseVerticesDirection
formula: =LAMBDA(vertices,LET(n, ROWS(vertices), DROP(REDUCE(0, SEQUENCE(n), LAMBDA(acc,i, VSTACK(acc, CHOOSEROWS(vertices, n - i + 1)))), 1)))
comment: Reverses the row order of a vertex list, swapping clockwise and counterclockwise. vertices is an n×2 array of (x, y) rows. One row is returned unchanged. Omitting vertices returns #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
